tool.name: Get Connector Action
tool.description: Retrieve a single endpoint from a connector template by name. Returns just the endpoint definition without the full template, saving significant context tokens (900 vs 15,000+).

connectorId.description: The connector template ID or slug

endpointName.description: The name of the endpoint to retrieve

nodes.name: Unwrap Action Response
nodes.description: Search for the endpoint in the template and return appropriate response
